syslog_enable.description: Enable Finit’s internal syslog helper for kernel and service logging.

console_device.description: Console device to use for kernel/service output (e.g., /dev/console, /dev/ttyS0). Leave empty for kernel default.

hostname.description: System hostname to set at boot (overrides kernel command line).

runlevels.description: Runlevels and services to activate per runlevel. Each entry defines a runlevel number and an ordered list of service names.

number.description: Runlevel number (e.g., 3 for multi-user, 5 for GUI).

services.description: List of service names to start in this runlevel (must match service names below).
List of system services to manage. Each service defines name, command, and optional lifecycle behavior.

name.description: Unique service name (e.g., sshd, network). Must match references in runlevels.

description.description: Optional human-readable description (not parsed — for documentation only).

cmd.description: Command to execute (full path and args). Must be non-blocking (e.g., -D for daemons) or use 'exec' wrapper.

pidfile.description: Path to PID file for process monitoring (required for non-daemonizing services).

restart_delay.description: Seconds to wait before restarting a crashed service.

start_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for service to signal readiness (via pidfile or watchdog).

restart_limit.description: Maximum restart attempts before disabling the service.

network_required.description: If true, service waits until basic network is up (uses /run/finit/network.state).

depends_on.description: Name of service that must be running before this one starts.

early_boot.description: If true, start this service *before* runlevel 3 (e.g., for filesystem checks).

ttys.description: Virtual console terminals to spawn (e.g., for login prompts).

baud_rate.description: Baud rate for serial/tty (only used if getty_cmd omitted).

getty_cmd.description: Full getty command to run (e.g., '/sbin/agetty -n tty2 38400'). If provided, overrides baud_rate and default getty.

poweroff_cmd.description: Custom command to execute on power button press (e.g., /sbin/poweroff). If omitted, defaults to /sbin/poweroff.

reboot_cmd.description: Custom command to execute on reboot (e.g., /sbin/reboot -f). If omitted, defaults to /sbin/reboot.
